findings.title: Netscaler leak? (r/Citrix thread, first public surfacing)
findings.summary_md: A sysadmin reported that their IT supplier's security team phoned to advise shutting NetScaler appliances down immediately, with nothing yet on the Citrix website or in tech news, and other sysadmins in the thread reporting the same. Tenable's September 27 FAQ states this thread carried details from an NCSC-NL pre-notification distributed TLP:AMBER+STRICT that had not been made public. The thread predates watchTowr's public confirmation by roughly ten hours and the story's first aggregated coverage by twelve.

findings.title: watchTowr on X: rapidly reacting to rumors of multiple unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: watchTowr publicly stated it was rapidly reacting to rumors that multiple unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE vulnerabilities were circulating, roughly two hours before the first aggregated news coverage in this story. The timestamp is derived from the post's snowflake ID. A follow-up watchTowr post at 22:19 UTC the same evening shared further information on both flaws and directed questions to Citrix.
